title: Fairness Metric Design Exploration in Multi-Domain Moral Sentiment Classification using Transformer-Based Models
findings: The paper does not analyze or make any findings related to religion or faith. The study's focus is on moral sentiment classification from a secular, psychological perspective.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures the fairness and performance of models in classifying moral sentiments in text from different social media domains (Twitter and Reddit). It is based on the secular Moral Foundation Theory, which defines universal moral foundations like 'care', 'fairness', 'loyalty', and 'authority', and is not designed to measure any aspect of religion or faith.
